Iteration: 1 - Register
Request Description
Registers a new user. Auth: none. Body: RegisterRequest {email: EmailStr, password: str}. Password validated by validate_secure_password: min length 6, requires an uppercase letter, a digit, and a special character (see app/core PASSWORD_RULE_MESSAGE). Success: 201 with UserResponse {id, email, created_at}. Errors: 422 if email invalid or password fails the secure-password rule. Duplicate email: no explicit ResourceConflictError/409 handling was found in AuthService.create_user or UserRepository.create - a duplicate email will likely raise an unhandled DB IntegrityError (TODO: verify actual status code, probably 500 unless a DB-level exception handler exists). Note: Duplicate email registration now returns 409 Conflict with detail "A user with this email already exists" (AuthService.create_user checks for an existing user before insert; previously this raised an unhandled IntegrityError -> 500). Credentials are generated once (pre-request script) and stored in the environment as qa-1786021202639-607035@example.com/***REDACTED-PASSWORD*** so Login and the duplicate-email negative test reuse the same user instead of registering a fresh random email each run.

Iteration: 1 - Stream Workflow Run Events
